about: Data for fig-two-paths: the phases of one __check_auth in a Perch account and in an OpenZeppelin v0.8.0 account whose rules carry oz-policy-builder's policy-interpreter and OpenZeppelin's spending_limit. Read from source, not measured. Sources: P = Perch at f0275f4; oz8 = OpenZeppelin stellar-contracts v0.8.0 packages/accounts/src; opb = oz-policy-builder at 43b13ed. The SVG, its narrow form and the text alternative are generated from this file.

perch.text: The host calls `__check_auth` with two contexts: the `guess`, then the transfer it makes.
perch.direct: The host calls `__check_auth` with one context: the transfer.
perch.io: receives the payload's rule IDs and signers

oz.text: The host calls `__check_auth`, which runs `do_check_auth` on the same two contexts.
oz.direct: The host calls `__check_auth`, which runs `do_check_auth` on one context: the transfer.

perch.text: Guards: reserved hooks, freeze, excluded set. Each rule ID resolves to a stored rule and its spending record.
perch.io: reads the rule set, scope tags, freeze and spending records

oz.text: Each rule must exist, be unexpired and match its context's contract; a signer on no selected rule is refused (3016).
oz.io: reads each selected context rule; checks each payload signer against the selected rules' signers

perch.text: `rule_eval::authorize` decides both contexts: function, recipient, signers, expiry and the window cap.
perch.direct: `rule_eval::authorize` decides the transfer alone; the window cap charges it.
perch.io: reads rules, records, ledger and grant generation; writes nothing

refusal.note: Perch refuses here, before any signer is authenticated: the transfer would exceed 2 XLM in the window. No verifier is called and nothing is written.

oz.text: No decision here: a rule with policies leaves it to them.
oz.io: with policies, the signer check is deferred to enforce

perch.text: digest = SHA-256(bound ‖ XDR(rule IDs)); bound hashes the payload with the account.
perch.io: computes the digest an external signer signs

oz.text: `AuthDigestPreimage` holds the account, the payload and the rule IDs.
oz.io: the value a delegated signer authorizes

perch.text: Calls the WebAuthn verifier contract: `verify(digest)` checks the passkey signature.
perch.io: one call out of the account, in this authorization entry

oz.text: The Stellar account authorizes `__check_auth(preimage)` in its own second authorization entry, which the host checks.

perch.text: No policies: the account decided in phase 3.

oz.text: Each rule's policies run `enforce` in stored order: the interpreter on the `guess`; on the transfer, `spending_limit` first, then the interpreter.
oz.direct: On the transfer, the policies run `enforce` in stored order: `spending_limit` first, then the interpreter.
oz.io: calls out of the account: each attached policy, in stored order (address order at rule creation; add_policy appends)

refusal.note: The OpenZeppelin account refuses here, in `spending_limit`, after the signer was authenticated and the interpreter permitted the `guess`; with `spending_limit` stored first, the transfer's interpreter call does not run.

perch.text: Stores the transfer rule's changed spending record in the account.

oz.text: Writes made in `enforce` stay: `spending_limit`'s history and the interpreter's TTL bumps.
oz.io: writes in the two policy contracts
